conditions.condition: Cross-skill schema dependency on `specflow:develop` Phase F.5 emitting `superseded_by_retro: false` as default. The runtime detection check (B.3 prerequisite refusal sentinel) is in place in the SKILL body, but the upstream `specflow:develop` enhancement PRD must land before `specflow:complete` v1 ships for the supersede-write path to fire on Phase F.5-written entries. Until the upstream PRD lands, every supersede-mode invocation refuses with the cross-skill-schema-unmet sentinel.
conditions.escalation_path: Author the `specflow:develop` enhancement PRD adding `superseded_by_retro: false` to Phase F.5's initial-write field set. Land via standard PRD chain (interview → PRD → tasks → develop). Sequence: enhancement PRD ships → `specflow:complete` v1 ships → users invoke without hitting the prerequisite-unmet sentinel.
